item.title: NCT Wish drops 4th EP, announces tour
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
NCT Wish is releasing the group's fourth EP, “I Spy,” on Monday, according to SM Entertainment. item.title: K-pop architect Lee Soo-man returns with double debut
item.description:
Korea Herald • Debut / new group
Lee Soo-man, founder of SM Entertainment and widely regarded as the architect of modern K-pop, is returning to the Korean music industry with the simultaneous debut of a boy group and a girl group under his new label, A2O Entertainment.
